name: Exp_NRTR_extr
summary: This EA trades based on the NRTR_extr (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse Extended) custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It implements a trailing reverse logic where trend changes trigger both entry in the new direction and exit from the opposite direction. Position sizing is configurable via multiple money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based allocation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于NRTR_extr自定义指标进行交易，在指标发出上行信号时开多仓，下行信号时开空仓。它实现了追踪反转逻辑，趋势变化时同时触发新方向入场和反方向出场。仓位管理支持多种资金管理模式，包括固定手数和基于余额/净值的百分比分配。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用NRTR_extr指标作为核心策略引擎，NRTR是一种自适应追踪止损指标，能够在趋势延续时跟随价格移动止损线，在趋势反转时切换方向。入场条件：当指标的第2和第3号缓冲区分别检测到上行信号（UpValue非零且非EMPTY_VALUE）时开多仓，检测到下行信号（DnValue非零且非EMPTY_VALUE）时开空仓。出场条件：反向信号触发时平仓，同时支持通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制是否允许信号平仓。此外，EA还检查第0和第1号缓冲区（止损线）来增强平仓判断，当同方向的开仓和平仓都启用且价格触及止损线时也会触发平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数(LOT)、基于净值(FREEMARGIN)、基于余额(BALANCE)、基于可用保证金减亏损(LOSSFREEMARGIN)和基于余额减亏损(LOSSBALANCE)。EA使用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）避免同一根K线内重复交易，并通过SignalBar参数允许选择信号来源的K线偏移。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the NRTR_extr indicator as its core strategy engine. NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) is an adaptive trailing stop indicator that moves the stop line with price during trend continuation and reverses direction on trend changes. Entry conditions: when indicator buffers 2 and 3 detect an upward signal (UpValue non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE), a buy position is opened; when a downward signal (DnValue non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE) is detected, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions: opposite signals trigger position closure, with BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters controlling whether signal-based closing is allowed. Additionally, the EA checks buffers 0 and 1 (trailing stop lines) to enhance exit decisions — when both open and close permissions are enabled for the same direction and price touches the trailing stop line, closure is also triggered. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot (LOT), based on free margin (FREEMARGIN), based on balance (BALANCE), based on free margin minus loss (LOSSFREEMARGIN), and based on balance minus loss (LOSSBALANCE). The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to avoid repeated trades within the same bar, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting the signal source bar offset.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或手数，根据MMMode决定含义
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size, meaning per MMMode

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：固定手数/基于净值/基于余额等

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线偏移量，0为当前K线

pros: 使用NRTR自适应追踪止损指标，能动态调整止损线跟随趋势，有效捕捉趋势行情
提供五种仓位管理模式，资金管理灵活度高，适应不同风险偏好
具有新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
开仓和平仓信号可独立控制（BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），策略配置灵活
双重平仓判断机制（信号线+止损线），减少趋势反转时的延迟出场
pros_en: Uses the adaptive NRTR trailing stop indicator that dynamically adjusts stop lines to follow trends, effectively capturing trending markets
Provides five position sizing modes with high flexibility in money management, accommodating different risk preferences
Implements new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Independent control of open and close signals (BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose) for flexible strategy configuration
Dual exit judgment mechanism (signal line + trailing stop line) reduces delayed exits during trend reversals
cons: 依赖自定义指标NRTR_extr，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行，且指标逻辑不透明
未包含点差过滤机制，在滑点较大的品种上可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值较大，在低波动品种上可能不合适
缺乏对持仓状态的检查，可能重复发单导致多重持仓
代码注释为乱码（编码问题），可读性和可维护性差
cons_en: Depends on custom NRTR_extr indicator — EA fails to run if the indicator file is missing, and indicator logic is opaque
No spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable fills on high-spread instruments
Default StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are large and may be unsuitable for low-volatility instruments
Lacks explicit position state checking before opening, potentially causing duplicate orders and multiple positions
Code comments are garbled (encoding issue), severely hurting readability and maintainability
improvements: 添加点差过滤和多持仓检查机制，避免高滑点环境下不利成交和重复开仓
将止损止盈参数改为基于ATR的动态计算，使其自适应不同品种的波动性
修复源文件编码问题，恢复俄语注释的可读性，并添加英文注释
improvements_en: Add spread filtering and position state checking before opening to avoid unfavorable fills in high-slip environments and duplicate positions
Convert StopLoss and TakeProfit from fixed point values to ATR-based dynamic calculation for better adaptation to different instrument volatilities
Fix source file encoding to restore Russian comment readability and add English comments for broader accessibility

risk_points: 缺乏持仓状态检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
固定止损止盈值不适应所有品种，低波动品种可能止损过大而高波动品种止盈过小
依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失或版本不匹配会导致初始化失败
risk_points_en: No position state checking before opening, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit values don't adapt to all instruments — too wide for low-volatility and too narrow for high-volatility pairs
Dependency on external custom indicator — missing or version-mismatched indicator causes initialization failure
